item.description:
Symphonia 1.0.3 keeps the server running when an update briefly blocks its network access.

  • No more "Write host unreachable". Right after an update, macOS can block Symphonia from announcing itself on the network for a short time. Before, that stopped the whole server, including the status page, until you chose Try Again. Now Symphonia keeps serving music and tries again 30 seconds later.
  • Reconnects sooner. If players can't find Symphonia, it reconnects after 2 minutes instead of 10, then keeps trying every 5 minutes. The status page shows a warning until it succeeds.
  • Simpler advice. If the warning is still there after 10 minutes, quit and reopen Symphonia. Turning Symphonia off and on again in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Local Network is only needed if that doesn't help.
